title: Larabanga Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: Mapped historic mosque envelope from OSM way 709927303, with the national board’s approximate 8m body dimensions.

terrainReference.basis: Public source elevation near the photographed south entrance.

mapIdentity.provider: OpenStreetMap mosque way 709927303 and named node 7067987939, with the University of Ghana inventory and the Ghana Museums and Monuments Board description.
mapIdentity.scope: The native historic mosque envelope and named point establish the site beside the baobab. The Ghana Museums and Monuments Board supplies the approximate 8m square body. Buttresses project from that body within the wider mapped envelope.

note: The two cleared photos show the restored mud-plaster form, unequal towers, tapered buttresses, dark base, torons and patterned entrance panel. The photographed proportions guide the roof and tower heights.
